You see a small emerald.
It weighs 0.10 oz.

    Notes

    2 of them are obtained in the Isle of the Mists Quest, 1 of them is obtained in The Exterminator Quest, and 6 of them are obtained during the Rise of Devovorga World Quest.

    1 is needed to access Feyrist in an earth Holy Shrines.

    History

    Before Summer Update 2017, it could be enchanted by Premium Druids of level 30 or higher in Earth Shrines.
